comment: Launch option presets. kind: env (KEY=VALUE before %command%), wrapper (a command that wraps the game), arg (passed to the game after %command%). Presets in the same group replace each other.

presets.label: GameMode
presets.help: Runs the game through Feral GameMode (CPU governor and I/O priority). Bazzite and most desktop distros ship it; SteamOS doesn't need it.

presets.label: MangoHud overlay
presets.help: FPS, frame time and temperatures in an overlay. On a Steam Deck, the built-in performance overlay does the same.

presets.label: Proton log
presets.help: Writes steam-<appid>.log to your home folder each run; read it in DeckWrench's Logs. Turn it off again when done: logs grow fast.

presets.label: Use WineD3D (OpenGL)
presets.help: Renders DirectX 9-11 through OpenGL instead of DXVK. Slower; for games that crash or show black screens with DXVK.

presets.label: Turn off esync
presets.help: For the rare game that hangs or stutters with eventfd synchronization.

presets.label: Turn off fsync
presets.help: For the rare game that hangs with futex synchronization.

presets.label: Use NTSYNC
presets.help: Kernel-level Windows synchronization (GE-Proton 10 and newer, kernel 6.14+ with the ntsync module).

presets.label: Native Wayland
presets.help: Uses Wine's Wayland driver instead of XWayland (GE-Proton 10 and newer). Needed for HDR outside Game Mode.

presets.label: NVAPI (DLSS on NVIDIA)
presets.help: Lets games see an NVIDIA GPU's NVAPI, for DLSS and Reflex. Desktop NVIDIA cards only.

presets.label: Hide NVIDIA GPU
presets.help: Reports an AMD GPU to games that misbehave on NVIDIA paths.

presets.label: DXVK FPS counter
presets.help: A small FPS counter drawn by DXVK (DirectX 9-11 games).

presets.label: DXVK async shaders
presets.help: Compiles shaders in the background to cut stutter. Only GE-Proton builds with the gplasync patch use it; never in online games with anti-cheat.

presets.label: Cap at 60 FPS (DXVK)
presets.help: DXVK's own frame limiter, for games without one.

presets.label: Cap at 40 FPS (DXVK)
presets.help: 40 FPS: smooth on the Steam Deck's screen at 40 Hz, and easy on the battery.

presets.label: Ray tracing (VKD3D)
presets.help: Turns on DirectX Raytracing in VKD3D-Proton for DirectX 12 games that support it.

presets.label: DirectX 12 feature level 12_2
presets.help: Reports feature level 12_2 to games that check for it (some DirectX 12 Ultimate titles).

presets.label: Load dinput8.dll from the game
presets.help: Native-first dinput8, the override most DLL mod loaders (Ultimate ASI Loader, script hooks) need.

presets.label: Start in DirectX 11
presets.help: For games that offer DX11 and DX12; DX11 is often smoother through DXVK.

presets.label: Start in DirectX 12
presets.help: Forces the DX12 renderer in games that offer both.

presets.label: Skip the publisher launcher
presets.help: Common flag for games with a pre-launcher (works in some Bethesda, 2K and Paradox titles).
